description: This file provides utility functions for handling HTTP responses, including setting security headers, sending JSON or text responses, handling errors, reading JSON request bodies, and setting server-sent events headers. It is used for common HTTP response handling in a server application.

methods.name: setDefaultSecurityHeaders
methods.description: Sets baseline security headers on the HTTP response, with optional strict transport security.

methods.name: sendJson
methods.description: Sends a JSON response with specified status code and body.

methods.name: sendText
methods.description: Sends a plain text response with specified status code and body.

methods.name: sendMethodNotAllowed
methods.description: Sends a 405 Method Not Allowed response with allowed methods.

methods.name: sendRateLimited
methods.description: Sends a 429 Too Many Requests response with optional Retry-After header.

methods.name: sendGatewayAuthFailure
methods.description: Handles authentication failure, sending rate limit or unauthorized responses based on auth result.

methods.name: sendInvalidRequest
methods.description: Sends a 400 Bad Request response with an error message.

methods.name: readJsonBodyOrError
methods.description: Reads and parses JSON request body, handling errors like payload too large or timeout.

methods.name: writeDone
methods.description: Writes a SSE 'done' message to the response.

methods.name: setSseHeaders
methods.description: Sets headers for server-sent events streaming.
